betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Opening a door straight into vacuum is a bad idea. The §6Airlock Door§f gives you a pressurized transition between sealed rooms and the void.

It's a 2x3 double-door system that opens in two stages: inner door first, then outer, maintaining pressure on both sides. The GUI shows oxygen levels on each side and warns you if you try to open the outer door without a suit.

This is not a vanilla door. No redstone control, right-click to open, right-click again to close. Both halves move together.

For a proper airlock setup, place two doors in series with a Gas Charge Pad between them. Inner door, charge pad, outer door. That way you can suit up, charge, and exit without losing atmosphere.

§cWARNING:§f Placing two airlock doors in series is the correct way to build an airlock. A single door won't maintain pressure properly.
